4881-5929-6909-8198.manaNeeded: {4}{B}{G} plus {2}{B} if Activated Sleeper is in your hand
4881-5929-6909-8198.description:
Cast Trystan's Command by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Carnage.
Put the nontoken Carnage into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Carnage token enters, it triggers, putting Activated Sleeper from your graveyard onto the battlefield, or another applicable card otherwise.
If Activated Sleeper was not returned in step 3, cast it by paying {2}{B}. Regardless, choose to have Activated Sleeper enter as a copy of Carnage.
Put Activated Sleeper into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Activated Sleeper enters, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Carnage.
Repeat from step 5.

141-2921-5100.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-2921-5100.description:
Cast Return Upon the Tide by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Return Upon the Tide.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Naru Meha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Return Upon the Tide
Resolve the Return Upon the Tide copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1322-3490-5477-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature token that has not been tapped this turn.
1322-3490-5477-7075.description:
Activate a creature token by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

2577-3899-4826-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control another Zombie.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
2577-3899-4826-7084.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-1417-3249-6723--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-1417-3249-6723--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from A Realm Reborn by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Bridge from Below triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

1742-4050-5003-7848.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three graveyards that each have seven or more cards in them.
1742-4050-5003-7848.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing The Master of Lake-town.
When The Master of Lake-town dies, it and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Master of Lake-town trigger, drawing a card for each graveyard that has seven or more cards in it.
Holding priority, activate Skirge Familiar by discarding a card, adding {B}.
Repeat step 4 two additional times.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return The Master of Lake-town from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.
1742-4050-5003-7848.notes: If your graveyard has six cards in it, you can count that as one of the graveyards with seven cards in it, as The Master of Lake-town will count as the seventh card.

364-1018-1987.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
364-1018-1987.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Skullwinder.
When Skullwinder enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
364-1018-1987.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

2440-2703-5434.description:
Activate Myr Propagator by paying {3} and tapping it, creating a token copy of it.
When the Myr Propagator token enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Myr you control.
Repeat using the Myr Propagator token instead.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Avatar Kuruk

804-7009-7638.manaNeeded: {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn
804-7009-7638.description:
Activate Sakashima the Impostor using Avatar Kuruk's ability by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, The Mind Stone triggers, blinking Sakashima the Impostor. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat each turn.

2438-6602--5.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Tromell
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat

4487-5660-6872.description:
Cast Phyrexian Marauder by paying {0}.
Phyrexian Marauder enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Long Feng triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Phyrexian Marauder from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1806-2060-3129-5686-7367.description:
Activate Eternal Scourge's scavenge ability, granted to it by Young Deathclaws, by paying {3} and exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard, putting six +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Primal Vigor.
Activate Crystalline Crawler six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Eternal Scourge.
Repeat.

2034-4871-5795-6747-7147.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Barkform Harvester by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {U} due to Sami.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

2085-5921-5970-6965.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Kelpie Guide.
Activate one of the Kelpie Guide tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Kelpie Guide token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

2921-4488-7084.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Rampaging Baloths triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

4050-5078-5243-7028.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Wan Shi Tong's second ability triggers, creating two 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Spirit, adding {1}.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Repeat.

719-1486-1753-7014.description:
Activate North Pole Patrol by tapping it, targeting Samut.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the North Pole Patrol ability, untapping Samut.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Activate Samut by paying {W} and tapping it, targeting North Pole Patrol.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Samut trigger, untapping North Pole Patrol.
Repeat.
719-1486-1753-7014.notes: Once you have infinite Treasures, you may use them to activate Magda's ability.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4659-4907-6972.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Tatterkite
When Tatterkite dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its static effect.
Repeat.

3532-3581-5078-5240.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Oneirophage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Kykar triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Activate Kykar by sacrificing the Spirit, adding {R}.
Repeat.

2639-3254-4050-5915.manaNeeded: {4}{G/W}{B}{B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
2639-3254-4050-5915.description:
Cast Nethroi either from your hand or from the command zone for its mutate cost by paying {4}{G/W}{B}{B}, putting it under a non-Human creature you control.
Nethroi triggers, returning Stickytongue Sentinel and Mitotic Slime from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Stickytongue Sentinel enters, it triggers, returning Nethroi from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Stickytongue Sentinel and Mitotic Slime, adding {B}{B}.
When Mitotic Slime dies, it triggers, creating two 2/2 Ooze creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Oozes, adding {1}{G/W}.
When the Oozes die, they trigger, creating four 1/1 Ooze creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Oozes, adding {3}.
Repeat.
2639-3254-4050-5915.notes: During step 2, you can recur other creatures with suitable powers. This will allow you to forego sacrificing that many Oozes in step 8, netting infinite mana and creature tokens. If you have infinite mana and Oozes, you can then forego reanimating Mitotic Slime and reanimate anything else with a suitable power instead.

2173-3944-5220-6634.description:
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it.
When Blood Pet dies, Mortuary and Al Bhed Salvagers trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Blood Pet from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Al Bhed Salvagers trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Blood Pet from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

1089-1495-6822.description:
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Curiosity triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Lyla triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelion.
Repeat.

955-1563-2457-4321.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token and a Food token.
Activate the Insect and Food by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

2457-3000-4289-4785.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

647-2615-6562.description:
Cast Tree of Perdition by paying {3}{B}.
When Tree of Perdition enters the battlefield, Jaws of Defeat triggers, targeting an opponent.
If the opponent has 13 or more life, hold priority and then activate Tree of Perdition by tapping it, swapping its toughness with an opponent's life total.
Resolve the Jaws of Defeat trigger, causing the opponent targeted in step 3 to lose life equal to Tree of Perdition's toughness.
The opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having 0 or less life.
647-2615-6562.notes: Regardless of the opponent's life total, they will go down to 0 or less life and lose the game. If their life total is 12 or less, they lose 13 life from the Jaws of Defeat trigger and lose. If they have 13 or more life, their life total becomes 13 and they will lose at least 13 life from the Jaws of Defeat trigger.

1563-1753-2351-6460.easyPrerequisites:
You control a token.
It is an opponent's turn.
1563-1753-2351-6460.description:
Activate Hardened Tactician by paying {1} and sacrificing a token.
If you sacrificed a Tentacle, The Watcher's second ability triggers if the creature token was a Tentacle, untapping a Kraken and putting a stun counter on up to one nonland permanent.
Resolve the Hardened Tactician ability, causing you to draw a card.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Activate the Tentacle by tapping it, adding {G}.
Repeat.

1575-2921-4231.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
1575-2921-4231.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing a Food.
Nuka-Cola Vending Machine triggers, creating a tapped Treasure artifact token, a tapped Clue artifact token and a tapped Food artifact token.
Resolve the ability from step 1.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Enigma Jewel // Locus of Enlightenment
Matzalantli, the Great Door // The Core

74-943-6071.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two permanent cards in your graveyard.
74-943-6071.description:
Activate The Core by tapping it, adding at least two mana of any color.
Activate Deserted Temple's second ability by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting itself.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying Deserted Temple's ability, targeting The Core.
Resolve both Deserted Temple abilities, untapping it and The Core.
Repeat.
74-943-6071.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may untap any other land except The Core instead.

3447-4013-4067.notablePrerequisites:
You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {C}.
You control at least one additional creature, or the permanent can tap to produce at least {1}{C}.
3447-4013-4067.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {C}.
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Tishana.
When Tishana enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to draw a card for each creature you control.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping the mana-producing permanent.
Activate the mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {C}.
Repeat from step 4 until you have at least {2}{C} in your mana pool.
Repeat from step 2.
If you control additional creatures and/or the mana-producing permanent produces at least {1}{C}, this combo nets near-infinite mana and near-infinite card draw.

1645-1765-3000-5231.description:
Cast Crown of Flames by paying {R}, targeting any creature you control.
When Crown of Flames enters the battlefield, Chishiro triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel and a 2/2 Spirit creature token.
Activate Thermopod's second ability twice by sacrificing the Spirit and Squirrel, adding {R}{R}.
Activate Crown of Flames' second ability by paying {R}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1020-1822-3689-4659.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken artifact with mana value one or less that can be cast using only colorless mana.
1020-1822-3689-4659.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the nontoken artifact with mana value one or less and Myr Retriever, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When Myr Retriever dies, its ability triggers twice, returning Workshop Assistant and the nontoken artifact with mana one or less to your hand from your graveyard.
Cast Workshop Assistant and the nontoken artifact by paying at most {4}.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the nontoken artifact and Workshop Assistant, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When Workshop Assistant dies, it triggers twice, returning the nontoken artifact and Myr Retriever to your hand from your graveyard.
Cast the nontoken artifact and Myr Retriever by paying at most {3}.
Repeat.

774-4826-5249.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least three basic snow lands.
Archelos is untapped.
774-4826-5249.description:
Activate three basic snow lands you control by tapping them, adding {3}.
Activate Icebreaker Kraken by returning the three snow lands from the battlefield to your hand.
Holding priority, activate Patron of the Moon twice by paying {2}, putting the three snow lands from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
Repeat.

224-1999-2119.notablePrerequisites: Master Transmuter does not have summoning sickness.
224-1999-2119.description:
Activate Seat of the Synod by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Master Transmuter by paying {U}, tapping it and returning Seat of the Synod from the battlefield to your hand, putting Seat of the Synod from your hand onto the battlefield.
Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Master Transmuter.
Repeat.

1720-3096-4551.description:
Cast Spoils of the Vault by paying {B}, naming any card not in your library, exiling your entire library and losing life equal to the number of cards exiled this way.
Activate Jace's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing target player to mill two cards and you to win the game due to drawing from an empty library.
